## Standing operator rules
Run “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” between other work. Execute in order: check Travis; create `gha/test-workflow`; inspect settings; create workflow directory; write replacement; lint; commit; push; then run `travis disable`.

Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

All changelog entries mentioning tax handling must include the Jira issue key in parentheses and be tagged with the `tax-doc` label by @marco.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

The `ci-runner-small` pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target `ci-runner-arm64` from now on.

## Current objective
Add vendor-credit CSV import. SQLAlchemy modernization is paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`gha/test-workflow`; `.github/workflows/test.yml`; tenant 73. `InvoicePage(items,total,limit,offset)` replaced the bare-list contract. Current runner: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` index: doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress
GHA: check Travis, branch, settings, directory, replacement done; lint, commit, push, `travis disable` pending. Next: `ruff check .github/workflows/test.yml`. Optimization commit status unknown. CSV import pending; no next command established.

## Recent work
SQLAlchemy changes passed 149 tests and lint. Replaced invoice `print` with structured logger; no subsequent result observed.
